g.text: Gondwana - Engine Frame and Rendering Sequence
[Each non-GL surface - bitmap render pass (all surfaces first)]
[Each non-GL surface - bitmap presentation pass (after all renders)]
Snapshot full / dirty rect as needed
Desktop GPU GL paint (independent of engine cycle)
Draw image on GL framebuffer; dispose image
Browser GPU path (no desktop snapshot mailbox)
[New scene frame due, or GPU backbuffer recreated]
Draw current GPU surface into canvas
Draw existing GPU surface into canvas
Blazor bitmap instead uses host OnAnimationFrame()
to drive Engine.Tick() from its own JS rAF loop.
Browser GPU paint owns the simulation Tick and
renders only when the backbuffer or frame is due.
